facts.value: Discover new cultures and broaden your perspectives with a study abroad experience during your studies, such as an internship or job in research.
You can participate in a study abroad or ERASMUS program!
Improve your language skills, get to know new cultures, and gain valuable international experience for your success in the job market.
Information on searching, organizing, and funding internships abroad as well as important application deadlines is available.
Student teachers can find all information related to internships abroad at the Academy for Educational Research and Teacher Education (ABL).
Here you can find helpful information on the execution of the ERASMUS program and support for departmental collaborations, as well as snippets for your website on the topic of international.
Administrative and technical staff at Goethe University can find information on possible stays abroad.
